arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS user_count FROM users u JOIN cards c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE u.credit_score >= 750 AND c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users with a credit score of 750 or higher who have at least one card of type 'Debit (Prepaid)'.
assumptions: Owning a card means the card's user_id is that user; card expiry is not checked.
